name: Tomorrow Is Ours
description: The story revolves around the people of Sète, France. Their lives are punctuated by family rivalries, romance and scenes from daily life, but also by plots involving police investigations, secrets and betrayals.

videos.title: The Trap (1)
videos.overview:
It was supposed to be a simple hike. A few hours' stroll in the spectacular Cirque de Mourèze for Chloé, Anna, and Mathieu, her colleague with the devastating smile, as well as Rose, who, completely charmed by the young man, had invited herself along unannounced.

But their outing suddenly turns into a nightmare when a stranger appears and takes the group hostage.

Dr. Marianne Delcourt is quickly contacted.

videos.title: The Trap (2)
videos.overview:
Dr. Marianne Delcourt is contacted almost immediately. To save her daughters, she will have to commit an unspeakable act against one of her patients, without informing either her family or the police.

This meticulously planned hostage situation will expose the deepest feelings, aspirations, rivalries, and resentments within the Delcourt family and their circle.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Two boats collide off the coast of Sète. There are fatalities. Chloé is worried: her son, Maxime, has disappeared. Where is he? What happened? Who was on the boats?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Chloé is trying to understand why her son is in police custody. An unknown woman was found on the beach; she was on one of the boats. Who is she?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Chloé and her mother, Marianne, discover Anna in a coma. Chloé wants to understand what happened to her sister. Why did she return to Sète after 17 years away? Why did she hide her identity from Maxime?

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview:
Chloé meets Martin, her sister's partner.

He's in Sète, incognito, searching for evidence to exonerate Anna.

Chloé joins him in the investigation.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Anna woke up with amnesia. She learns that she is pregnant, but by whom? Chloé helps her regain her memory.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview:
The initial findings of the investigation show that a bomb was planted on Anna and Lyès's boat. Anna and Maxime are therefore cleared.

But who planted the bomb and why?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview:
Maxime is released. Flore discovers that Martin lied.

Did he discover the affair between Lyès and Anna?

Did he plant the bomb on the boat as revenge?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview:

Will Karim and Chloé manage to find them in time?

videos.title: Episode 9

videos.title: Episode 10

videos.title: Episode 12

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: After viewing the footage, Karim and Lucie believe Bart raped Margot, but how can they prove it? Meanwhile, Anna is still being threatened, and Chloé and Martin are trying to figure out who could possibly have such a grudge against her.
